verdict.headline: No trade today
verdict.reason: No pair produced a break with a holding retest and a candle trigger before the 2:00pm PT expiry. The NFP breaks on USD/CAD and GBP/USD never retested, and the other pairs stayed inside their ranges.

watchlist.missing: Short watch. Price is below support after the NFP spike (long wick to about 1.3361), but there is only one candle of follow-through, no retest yet and no engulfing or pin-bar trigger. Needs the retest of about 1.3382 to reject from below. If SL sits 2-3 pips above the retest swing, the TP must be at least 2R away. Indicators (M5 chart): EMA 20 is below EMA 50 and price is below both, which agrees with a short. RSI is about 30, at the oversold edge, so the EMA + RSI check is borderline. It fails if RSI is below 30 or turns back up at the retest.

No break yet. Price is about 158.40, between support at 157.78 and resistance at 158.67, after a news spike that wicked to about 158.60 and failed to reach the level. Indicators: EMA 20 is above EMA 50, price is above both and RSI is about 63, so the uptrend agrees with a long, but there is nothing to grade until a level closes beyond. A long needs a close above about 158.67, follow-through, an M5 structure break, a retest that holds and an engulfing or pin bar. The overnight dip under 157.78 closed back above it, so that break failed.

No break yet. On the re-marked M5 chart, price sold off to support at about 211.37 (wick to about 211.34), bounced and is back near 211.56. Support held and nothing has closed beyond it. Indicators: EMA 20 is below EMA 50, price is below both and RSI is about 39, so the downtrend agrees with a short. A short needs an M5 close below about 211.37 with displacement, follow-through, a structure break, a retest that holds from below and an engulfing or pin bar. About 91 pips above, resistance is at about 212.28.

No break. Price was rejected at resistance (about 0.6893, highs to about 0.6894 with no close above) and has fallen back to about 0.6879, into the EMA 20/50 (RSI about 52). The long side has failed for now. A fresh setup needs an M5 close above about 0.6893 with a retest that holds, or a close below support at about 0.68545 with a retest from below, each with an engulfing or pin bar.

No qualifying setup. On the re-marked M5 chart (1:31pm), price pushed above about 1.4127 to about 1.4138, then a strong red candle closed back below the level (to about 1.4118), so that break failed and is a C. Price is back at about 1.4127 with small candles, no retest rejection and no engulfing or pin bar. EMA 20 is above EMA 50 with price on them, but RSI is about 47. With the setup expiry at 2:00pm PT, there is no time left for a valid entry.

newsBlocks: USD NFP and CAD employment came out at 5:30am PT. No pair requalified afterwards.
watchFor: USD/CAD: a pullback to about 1.4082 that holds from above with an M5 bullish engulfing or pin bar, with RSI back under 70.
GBP/USD: a retest of about 1.3382 from below that rejects with an M5 bearish engulfing or pin bar. A close back above 1.3382 downgrades it and it stays C.
Only the GBP/JPY chart was sent, so other pairs were not graded.
USD/JPY: a displacement close above about 158.67 with a holding retest, or a close below 157.78 with a retest from below.
GBP/JPY: an M5 close below about 211.37 with displacement, then a retest that holds from below (short, needs 1:2). A close above about 212.28 would be the long side.
AUD/USD: a displacement close above about 0.6893 and a holding retest, or a rejection candle at 0.6893 for a short.
